page_numbering: one-based PDF page; printed page numbers agree for these files

main.content_status: not distributed with the repository; identified by SHA-256, byte size and page count

supplementary.content_status: not distributed with the repository; identified by SHA-256, byte size and page count

interpretation_precedence: Use the 20-page main manuscript for its current claims and scope; keep explicitly disclosed supplementary discrepancies visible rather than harmonizing values.

abstract_and_section_claims.label: Abstract and results
abstract_and_section_claims.note: Loss/metric/cost summaries describe author measurements; exchange rates and amortization are derived. The legacy paired_CE key includes mean BCE.

main_table_1_policy_and_deployment_ledge.label: Table 1
main_table_1_policy_and_deployment_ledge.note: Official test paired effects; intervals reported at 95%. All reported admission is descriptive. Multi-graph confirmation/admission reused validation.

main_table_2_gain_and_cost_ledger.label: Table 2
main_table_2_gain_and_cost_ledger.note: C_expected uses the measured branch ledger. C_assure is a separate two-branch configuration. C_099 and ranges are a tail-scenario model. Exchange rates and amortization are derived from effects and costs; not new measurements.

supplementary_table_S4_target_qualificat.label: Table S4
supplementary_table_S4_target_qualificat.note: Multi-graph values are post-decision validation diagnostics, not tabulated training-only qualification. phi_registry has a different denominator from the S7 qualified fraction.

supplementary_table_S6c_sensing_cost_ide.label: Table S6c
supplementary_table_S6c_sensing_cost_ide.note: Printed values retained at source precision.

supplementary_table_S12_selection_ledger.label: Table S12
supplementary_table_S12_selection_ledger.note: Retained outer-fold representative configurations, not the complete candidate-level selection trace. Their open-loop reselection optimism differs from nested S12b.

supplementary_table_S12c_selection_rule_.label: Table S12c
supplementary_table_S12c_selection_rule_.note: Registered upper-limit rule matches four of seven representative selections; the full executed trace is not supplied.

supplementary_table_S13_independent_grap.label: Table S13
supplementary_table_S13_independent_grap.note: D_bar/S2/J are reported fixed-ensemble admission moments; Ua and penalty are derived. Sensitivity holds those moments fixed while changing B, not a measured re-clipping run. Validation reuse makes Ua descriptive.

supplementary_table_S14_mechanism_contra.label: Table S14
supplementary_table_S14_mechanism_contra.note: Printed values retained at source precision.

supplementary_table_S14b_separated_data_.label: Table S14b
supplementary_table_S14b_separated_data_.note: Effects fixed; SE scaled by sqrt(J_old/J_new) and Holm family re-formed. No observed separated-data replicate is implied.

supplementary_table_S14b_unchanged_contr.label: Table S14b
supplementary_table_S14b_unchanged_contr.note: Six source contrasts retain their unit and reported statistics; Holm adjustments are re-formed in the analytical family.

supplementary_table_S15_method_compariso.label: Table S15
supplementary_table_S15_method_compariso.note: Official scores are author-reported rerun measurements. Resource ranges are declared references; S15b supplies per-rerun costs. Full-depth plant is qN, not q0.

supplementary_table_S15b_per_rerun_resou.label: Table S15b
supplementary_table_S15b_per_rerun_resou.note: Printed values retained at source precision.

supplementary_table_S16_arxiv_factorial.label: Table S16 and Figure S17d
supplementary_table_S16_arxiv_factorial.note: Cells are reported measurements. Cell010 is excluded from additivity interpretation because its trajectory/integration domain is unspecified. Figure S17d uncertainty assumes independence; joint covariance is not printed.

supplementary_table_S16b_pascal_factoria.label: Table S16b
supplementary_table_S16b_pascal_factoria.note: Measured decision-capable cells; effect-coded contrasts derived from them. Paired uncertainty requires their joint covariance, which is not supplied here.

supplementary_table_S20_selection_theore.label: Table S20
supplementary_table_S20_selection_theore.note: Reported empirical radii and family sizes; near-best slack is arithmetic and exceeds selected effect sizes. Conditional coverage is an assumption, not established by this table.

supplementary_table_S21_action_gap_audit.label: Table S21
supplementary_table_S21_action_gap_audit.note: Printed values retained at source precision.

supplementary_table_S22_trajectory_tube_.label: Table S22
supplementary_table_S22_trajectory_tube_.note: Empirical plug-in tube using sampled Lipschitz quantiles, not the worst-case deterministic bound. Violation is the complement of mode-stable coverage.

supplementary_table_S23_assurance_and_ex.label: Table S23
supplementary_table_S23_assurance_and_ex.note: Reported controller/comparator work, fallback, wall time, memory and qualification; expected and assurance costs use branch accounting. Maximum per-input cost not tabulated. Source GPU-hour units retain the R15 mismatch.

supplementary_table_S23b_nominal_executi.label: Table S23b
supplementary_table_S23b_nominal_executi.note: tnom is author-reported measured timing; anchor/reference ranges and M_star are analytical/derived.

supplementary_table_S26b_ensemble_law_an.label: Table S26b
supplementary_table_S26b_ensemble_law_an.note: D_infinity is the reported fit on the evaluated integer ensemble grid; bands/break-even are sensitivity model. Additional eight checkpoints beyond the 12 primary seeds are diagnostic cost.

supplementary_table_S30_oracle_dispersio.label: Table S30
supplementary_table_S30_oracle_dispersio.note: Oracle-depth summaries reported; clipped-effect SD derived from S13. Retained-share grid is analytical, not a bound on an independently trained predictor.

supplementary_table_S34_budget_aware_rul.label: Table S34
supplementary_table_S34_budget_aware_rul.note: Acquisition/execution outcomes reported; fixed-threshold gap and retained-fraction formulas are analytical references. Certificate constants and full acquisition traces are not tabulated.

supplementary_table_S37_input_fallback_c.label: Table S37; provenance classified in Table S31 p32
supplementary_table_S37_input_fallback_c.note: Supplied counts equal reported fraction times official test size, rounded; Table S31 calls this derived. Do not interpret them as a bundled independent event log.

supplementary_table_S41_qualification_co.label: Table S41
supplementary_table_S41_qualification_co.note: Six measured component totals; accounting-unit mismatch with per-checkpoint S5 remains. Products total is an explicitly derived S15 difference, not a S41 row.

supplementary_table_S42_power_of_budget_.label: Table S42
supplementary_table_S42_power_of_budget_.note: Analytical power/SE sensitivity from other reported contrasts, not observed E3 rejection frequencies.

supplementary_table_S44_per_input_cost_m.label: Table S44
supplementary_table_S44_per_input_cost_m.note: Modelled99th-percentile cost from resolvent-frequency scenarios; not observed maximum or hard cap.

supplementary_table_S45_inserted_site_at.label: Table S45
supplementary_table_S45_inserted_site_at.note: Arm point values and configuration ranges reported; arm2 is qC identity. Paired SE borrowed from S42 unit; no arm-specific paired CI is tabulated.

supplementary_table_S46_budget_matched_f.label: Tables S46 and S46b
supplementary_table_S46_budget_matched_f.note: Central arm outcomes and configuration ranges are author-reported. Ranges are not paired CIs; S46b does not tabulate arm-level adjusted P, actual-work observations or budget mismatch.

supplementary_table_S47_decision_boundar.label: Table S47
supplementary_table_S47_decision_boundar.note: Analytical retained-share grid, crossovers and power; central reported effect margins summarized. The ensemble-spend model uses extra assumptions outside the fixed-checkpoint deployment contract.

supplementary_table_S12b_nested_open_loo.label: Table S12b
supplementary_table_S12b_nested_open_loo.note: Printed values retained at source precision.

supplementary_table_S7_support_audit.label: Table S7
supplementary_table_S7_support_audit.note: Counts, propensities and fractions are retained author-reported summaries. Corrected common per-cell ESS/max-weight summaries are not tabulated, so these fractions do not independently validate support.

verification.method: Full text review of both PDFs; visual page checks for main11,14 and supplementary9,10,11,12,29. Numeric arithmetic checks are separate from empirical replication.

missing_historical_records: arm-level E3-E6 paired confidence intervals, adjusted P values and actual-work observations
